name: Powder to Ironband
summary: In Ironforge, the Explorer's League sends blasting powder south to Prospector Ironband's dig in Loch Modan. Prospector Stormpike approves the request, and the shipment goes to Thelsamar before continuing to Ironband's Excavation.

sections.title: Bureaucracy and Blasting Powder
sections.body: The Explorer's League sends blasting powder from Ironforge to Prospector Ironband's expedition in southern Loch Modan. When the dig runs short, word reaches the League's leaders. Prospector Stormpike approves the request and sends the runner to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar, the valley's main supply hub.

sections.title: A Missed Departure
sections.body: Earlier wagons through Loch Modan have vanished or faced harassment from local troggs. Stormpike orders you to guard the powder wagon yourself. But when you reach the Stoutlager Inn in Thelsamar, Jern Hornhelm has already sent it south with Huldar and two dwarven porters. You hurry down the road to catch them.

faq.q: Why is blasting powder being sent to Ironband?
faq.answer: Prospector Ironband leads a dwarven archaeological dig in southern Loch Modan. His team has used its blasting powder while digging through dense rock, as trogg aggression grows.

Prospector Stormpike is a senior officer of the Dwarven Explorer's League in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. He reviews field requests, approves critical equipment, and manages supplies for major dig sites across Khaz Modan.
Jern Hornhelm is an Explorers' League contact in Thelsamar, Loch Modan. He prepares supplies and organizes transport teams bound for the valley's more dangerous frontiers.

faq.q: Why was personal escort requested for this shipment?
faq.answer: Earlier shipments bound for Ironband's excavation failed to arrive. Troggs spilling from the hills and dig sites make Loch Modan's main road increasingly dangerous.

faq.q: What happens when you arrive in Thelsamar?
faq.answer: Jern Hornhelm has already sent the wagon with Huldar and the porters Miran and Saean. You follow the southern road to catch them before trouble strikes.

faq.q: How does this quest fit into the Explorer's League storyline?
faq.answer: This delivery carries the dig site's request through the League's authorities in Ironforge and back into the field through Thelsamar. The expedition can then keep excavating.

angles.text: As a dwarf, helping secure powder for an excavation supports the holy work of uncovering your people's mysterious origins.
As an Alliance traveler, helping keep Loch Modan's roads safe supports the ties between Ironforge and the eastern frontiers.
As a miner, you know blasting powder helps miners and excavators break through deep bedrock.
